title: Headcount sync prep — hiring & interview loop notes (scratchpad)
content:
TL;DR:
- Prep notes for the weekly headcount sync with Eng PMs + People Ops. Focus: confirm Q2 hiring priorities, unblock interview loops, review debrief action items, and surface any role-level risks (comp, interview bandwidth, offer velocity).

Goals for the meeting:
- Reconcile headcount plan vs current pipeline and offers.
- Prioritize 4 roles for immediate sourcing push.
- Get commitment on interview panel availability and expected decision SLAs.
- Follow up on feedback from last week's interview loop debriefs.

Agenda (30-40 min):
1) Quick status (5 min) — headcount numbers and open reqs
2) Priority roles (10 min) — agree top 4 to accelerate
3) Interview loops & debriefs (10 min) — outstanding feedback, blocker owners
4) Actions & dates (5 min) — assign owners and deadlines

Current headcount snapshot (quick numbers):
- Q2 target net +12 FTE (engineering-focused: +9 eng, +1 infra, +2 product)
- Current open/approved reqs: 18 (9 eng, 3 infra, 2 product, 4 other)
- Offers extended this month: 3 (2 accepted, 1 pending)
- Pipeline stage counts (approx): Sourced 120, Screened 60, Onsite/Loop 18, Offered 3

Priority roles to push this week (suggested):
1) Backend Engineer — infra-heavy (ENG-704) — critical for dedicated autoscale work
2) Serving Runtime Engineer (quantization/ops) (ENG-712) — high skill, low pipeline
3) Platform SRE (ENG-690) — capacity constraints on staging clusters
4) Product Manager — hosting & dedicated (PM-21) — product roadblocked without hire
Notes: confirm with hiring managers which of the above can interview next week; if panel availability < 3 ops for Backend, escalate to hiring manager to swap in alternate reviewers.

Interview loop feedback summary (recent debriefs):
- Candidate A (Serving Runtime): strong systems knowledge, weaker product communication. Team recommends second deep-dive on KV cache design before moving to offer.
- Candidate B (Backend): missed expected async patterns; recommend a focused take-home + follow-up pairing session.
- Candidate C (SRE): Excellent troubleshooting, concerns about on-call bandwidth (asked multiple clarifying Qs). Hiring manager wants to check reference for production incident response.

Outstanding blockers (from last debriefs):
- Loop logistics: panel scheduling delays — need panel backup list (2 alternate interviewers) for each critical role.
- Compensation alignment: one candidate requires L3 comp band confirmation (Finance sign-off needed).
- Interview docs: take-home instructions are slightly outdated for Serving Runtime test — engineering to update (see GH PR).

Proposed next steps (pre-meeting prep items for attendees):
- Hiring managers: bring 1-2 names for alternate interviewers (if you can't make the current panel).
- Recruiters: share up-to-date pipeline table (sheet link) and quick notes on candidate fit.
- Eng leads: confirm whether we can make exceptions on remote/location for infra roles (affects candidate pool).
- People Ops: have comp bands and offer templates ready for rapid approval.

Action items (to capture during sync) — draft list to refine in meeting:
- Jordan: consolidate final list of priority roles and update the Q2 headcount tracker (due 2026-03-01)
- Ava Chen: pull updated pipeline numbers and candidate CVs for the top 4 roles (due 2026-02-28)
- Maya Patel: update the Serving Runtime take-home prompt + open GH PR to owners (PR #34) (due 2026-02-27)
- Lena Rodriguez: follow up with Finance on L3 comp band approval for ENG-712 (due 2026-02-28)
- Eng Leads (TBD): provide alternate panelists for each priority role (due 2026-02-28)
- Recruiter (assigned): schedule second deep-dive for Candidate A and a pairing session for Candidate B (target: 1 week)

Notes to self / talking points during sync:
- Emphasize speed: offer velocity +clear decision windows (48-72h after onsite) will help conversion.
- Flag risk: Serving Runtime role is high impact + small candidate pool — recommend fast-tracking technique interviews and offering signing bonus if comp band allows.
- Suggest temporary interview panel expansion: include senior engineers from adjacent teams to reduce bottlenecks.

Follow-ups after meeting (template we'll use in follow-up doc):
- Updated headcount tracker snapshot (export)
- List of committed interviewers and scheduled loops
- Action log (owner, item, due date, status) — People Ops will own the living doc

Quick refs / links to bring: (put these in the meeting note)
- Headcount Confluence: confluence:HR-Headcount-Q2-2026
- Q2 tracker sheet: drive:sheet:Q2-Headcount-Tracker-2026
- GH PR for take-home update: github:github.com/redwood-inference/recruiting/pull/34
- Recent debrief summaries: drive:doc:debriefs/feb-21-2026
- Finance comp ticket: JIRA:HR-145

Open questions to bring up in sync:
- Can we reprioritize any non-engineering hires to free budget for additional eng headcount this quarter?
- Are there any org-level hiring freezes expected in Apr/May? (ask CFO in follow-up)
- Should we pilot a 2-week interview SLA for priority roles (panel commit + decision within 14 days)?

Scratchpad / rough ideas:
- Short-term: consider converting one open product role to a contract PM to unblock roadmap (faster time-to-fill).
- Medium-term: run a focused referral push for Serving Runtime — $3k bonus for hires in this band. Need leadership sign-off.
- Interview experiment: remove one behavioral round for senior ICs to speed up loop; keep deep technical and culture rounds. Measure impact on offer acceptance.

Any other items to surface? Add below before I send the meeting invite.

-- Jordan
